# Heinemann Farms LLC

> Custom handcrafted woodworking business based in Wisconsin, USA. Specializes in jewelry boxes, heirloom chests, custom furniture, camper interiors, cutting boards, shelving, and bespoke commissions. 25+ years of experience. All pieces made to order from solid hardwoods — no plywood, no shortcuts.

## About

Heinemann Farms LLC is a Wisconsin-based custom woodworking business with over 25 years of craftsmanship. Every piece is made to order from solid hardwoods including walnut, maple, cherry, and bird's eye maple. The business does not use plywood or particleboard. Joinery methods include hand-fitted finger joints, dovetails, and mortise & tenon construction.

## Services

- **Jewelry & Keepsake Boxes** — Signature piece. Handcrafted from walnut, maple, and cherry with flox-lined interiors, brass hardware, and hand-fitted finger joints.
- **Heirloom Chests** — Larger keepsake chests and treasure boxes built to be passed down. Wood species and design matched to the customer's story.
- **Custom Furniture** — Tables, benches, shelving, and more from solid hardwood to your dimensions, finish, and style.
- **Gift & Occasion Pieces** — Wedding gifts, retirement gifts, anniversary pieces. Custom engraving available.
- **Home Décor & Signs** — Serving boards, wall art, carved signs, and decorative pieces.
- **Camper & RV Interiors** — Custom-fit dinette tables, fold-down surfaces, and built-in woodwork designed to fit a specific camper or RV. Measured to fit.
- **Countertops & Cutting Boards** — Butcher block countertops, end-grain cutting boards, and stove covers. Food-safe and built to outlast the kitchen.
- **Custom Shelving** — Built-in shelving, cabinetry, and storage solutions from solid wood, designed around the customer's space.
- **Custom Commissions** — Unique one-off projects including car dashboard panels, rocking horses, mission chairs, live-edge coffee tables, and more.

## Materials

Solid hardwoods only: walnut, maple, curly maple, bird's eye maple, cherry, ash, oak, pine, and mahogany. No plywood or particleboard.

## Location

Wisconsin, USA. Custom orders accepted from anywhere. Contact via the website.

## Contact & Ordering

All work is custom and made to order. To start a project, submit a request through the contact form at https://heinemannfarmsllc.com — describe the piece, intended use, and any size or material preferences. Every commission starts with a conversation.
